disposition: Automation and small-batch manufacturing proposal rejected for now: capability and measurement requirements do not establish a material bottleneck or net benefit.

hypotheses.bottleneck: No demonstrated manual-test throughput or rework bottleneck; O3-C05 is a measurement requirement only.
hypotheses.current_path: Exact customer procedure unknown; existing OEM tests and instrument automation are documented.
hypotheses.failure_condition: Reject if no manual bottleneck exists, incumbent automation already suffices, uncertainty worsens, or fixture/setup cost dominates.
hypotheses.measurable_metric: Future comparison could measure operator minutes per accepted assembly, retest rate and trace completeness; no values assigned.
hypotheses.proposed_engineering_change: Do not advance automated VNA validation plus small-batch manufacture without an evidenced workflow gap.
required_inputs: Calibrated 40 GHz setup and reference planes
hypotheses.validation_method: Only after later authorization and a documented bottleneck: compare against the actual current process at equal measurement uncertainty and acceptance scope.
